_note: Copy to config/connectors.json (gitignored). 'enabled' is the default provider list for npm run enrich and the studio's Connectors panel, in priority order (the first provider wins a merged field; disagreements go to conflicts.json). Keys live in .env, never here. Every connector value is graded partly until a public source confirms it.
_revealPersonal: true (default): ask providers that charge extra for personal emails and mobile or personal phones to return them (Apollo reveal_personal_emails; reveal_phone_number too when providers.apollo.webhookUrl is set, since Apollo delivers phones to a webhook; Lusha phones; ZoomInfo mobile). In owner-run firms these are often the business contact of record. The extra credits are in the estimate. false skips them.
